# Mohd Zaid

> Applied AI engineer. Builds AI agents and LLM-powered systems and ships them into production. Currently at General Machines (https://generalmachines.ai/), researching agentic commerce: shopping agents, agent evals and Stripe checkout for live Shopify stores.

Background: 1+ year of professional experience since graduating in May 2025 (B.Tech CSE, SRM University). Through his final two years of college he built production software for startups in Go, TypeScript and Python, twice as a founding engineer: DEnergy Networks (Go, Cosmos SDK network taken from testnet to mainnet on 50+ nodes, Jan 2025 to Sept 2026) and Trench (real-time trading platform, zero to 1,000+ concurrent users at sub-100ms). Software development engineer intern at Mable.

Fits: applied AI / AI engineer, forward deployed engineer, founding or early-stage engineer, backend (Go, Python, TypeScript), full-stack, distributed systems. Open to conversations about the right role: remote, anywhere in India, or abroad with visa sponsorship.
